desktop_name.description: Human-readable name of the application as it appears in the desktop environment

desktop_comment.description: Short comment/description for the desktop entry

terminal.description: Whether the application should be run in a terminal window (must be 'true' or 'false')

exec_command.description: Command to execute when launching the application

categories.description: Desktop entry categories (semicolon-separated list); empty string is valid per desktop-entry-spec
